answer: Sybil farms fail a cooling-grove voyage: each new key starts as a hot ember that cannot claim reward until it finishes a timed voyage through N randomly assigned peer grove stations. At each station peers co-sign liveness and may slash if they later prove the same operator also answered from a second ember in that epoch. Shared control collapses every voyage into one scarred grove seat, so extra keys only lengthen the cooling path instead of multiplying payout.
